name: IM chat
purpose: Conversation fragment with room list, chat bubbles, markdown replies, and a rich-text composer.
scenarios: Read a seeded support thread with markdown from the assistant
Compose and send a reply from the editor
Show an empty state when the thread has no messages

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for bundled block copy.

onSend.description: Called with plain text after the composer is submitted.

variants.name: density
variants.description: Inherits density from token rungs rather than a local viewport query.

states.name: default
states.description: Thread has one or more messages.

antiPatterns: Do not treat the editor HTML as a sanitizer-complete store; user text is stripped to plain copy.
Do not claim 21 authored languages; 19 locales are ICU skeletons.

keyboard: Tab reaches rooms, bubbles, editor, toolbar, and send
Activate send to append the reply
a11y.focus: Composer and send stay in document order with a visible focus ring.
a11y.labeling: Rooms, thread, composer, and send have accessible names.

responsive.strategy: Rooms stack above the thread; @container at 48rem places rooms in a side column. No viewport media queries.

breakpoints.medium: Rooms sit in a side column at 48rem container inline-size.
breakpoints.large: Rooms remain in a side column.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction comes from locale language.
